thread:
maya: Quick announcement — we shipped SDK v2.8.0 and a coordinated docs refresh. 

maya: Important: the `auto_normalize_prompts` behavior will be removed in 60 days (2025-08-01). This was the legacy heuristic that trimmed trailing whitespace and auto-inserted separators. New default is strict-pass-through.

maya: Why: the heuristic caused subtle tokenization/QA regressions for structured-output use cases. We tested with major customers; most see cost/latency wins.

alex: Thanks Maya. Where's the migration guide?

maya: alex: migration guide + diff examples here: https://redwood.dev/docs/sdk/migrations/auto-normalize-v2.8 — includes code snippets for Py/JS + suggested tests.

jen: For Dedicated / Private customers — does this flip automatically?

maya: jen: Hosted will flip default on 2025-08-01. Dedicated customers get a 90-day grace window controlled by a runtime flag on the pool: `legacy_normalize=true`. Private (VPC/on-prem) installs need to apply the v2.8 agent patch — we shipped a hotfix bundle for the operator in the private repo.

sam: Can we provide an env override for apps that need old behavior temporarily?

maya: yes — use `REDWOOD_SDK_LEGACY_NORMALIZE=true` (env) OR pass `legacy_normalize: true` in the client config for programmatic opt-out. We'll log a deprecation warning once used.

alex: Code snippet for Py quick patch?

maya: alex: paste: 
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(legacy_normalize=True)
res = c.generate(...)
```

deploy-bot: docs-site: updated /sdk/migrations/auto-normalize-v2.8 — status: live :white_check_mark:

jen: Heads-up to support: please update canned responses and KB article about token diffs. @support-bot can you create a ticket for the triage doc?

support-bot: created ticket #DOC-1428 — "Auto-normalize deprecation KB update" and assigned to Support Docs. ETA 3 business days.

sam: Any telemetry/alerting changes we should expect?

maya: No schema changes in telemetry. We will add a metric `sdk.legacy_normalize.usage` to track opt-outs; won't affect billing.

alex: I'll clock a small PR to update quickstarts and the starter repo examples today.

maya: Action items: 
- docs: migration guide (live) + examples (complete)
- support: KB ticket created (#DOC-1428)
- eng/dedicated: expose pool flag (already staged)
- private: operator patch available in private repo

maya: If you maintain integrations, please pin to 2.7.x or set the opt-out env var before 2025-08-01. For questions, DM me or @docs.Thanks! :rocket:
